scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply IDENTITY --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply ROUTING --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply ANALYTICS_1 --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply IDENTITY --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply ROUTING --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply ANALYTICS_1 --local && wrangler dev
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && svelte-check --workspace packages/ui --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && bun run --cwd apps/standalone check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json wrangler.jsonc packages apps tests
scripts.build:cli: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/cli smoke

APP_ORIGIN.description: The app address with no path or trailing slash: https://flared.YOUR-SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev, where YOUR-SUBDOMAIN is the workers.dev subdomain of your Cloudflare account. Use the Worker name in place of flared if you change it. Not sure? Leave it empty: after the deploy, the Worker address shows the exact value to set.

AUTH_SECRET.description: A random value of 32 to 256 characters that signs sessions. Generate one at https://flared.page/secrets or with: openssl rand -base64 48

SETUP_SECRET.description: A different random value of at least 32 bytes, from the same page. You type it once at /setup to create the owner; delete it afterwards.

IDENTITY.description: Accounts, sessions, the workspace, and its limits.

ROUTING.description: Short links, domains, and reserved slugs.

CLICKS.description: Click events from redirects to the analytics database.
